messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — planning a fractional release for `release/2026.03` tomorrow in the 02:00-04:00 PT window. Goal is a low-risk ramp for the new routing fallback and KV-cache tweak. Outline below, ping the owners you need: 

Aisha: Proposed ramp (region order: us-west -> us-east -> eu-west): 0.5% for 15m -> 1% for 15m -> 5% for 20m -> 20% for 20m -> 100% if green. If any gate trips, immediate rollback to previous variant.

Cheng: I can be deploy owner. I’ll kick things off and monitor deploy logs. Will you want the dedicated GPU pool pinned for the 20% stage?

Aisha: Yes pin the dedicated pool at the 20% threshold — we don’t want noisy autoscale during the heavy stage. Add `pool:dedicated-release-p1` to the canary config.

Sam: I’ll own smoke tests. My checklist: sanity chat response, median p50 token latency, error rate, and embed similarity jobs. If p50 > 220ms or error rate > 0.8% for >5m, I’ll call rollback.

Ben: Which dashboards/traces should we watch? I can set a temporary alert rule.

Sam: Watch `infra/latency/p50`, `api/errors/5m`, and `model/kv-cache/hitrate`. Also watch `reranker/quality/delta` for regressions. I’ll create a lightweight panel.

Natalie: Rollout policy snippet (add to release config):
```yaml
rollout:
  stages:
    - percent: 0.5
      duration: 15m
    - percent: 1
      duration: 15m
    - percent: 5
      duration: 20m
    - percent: 20
      duration: 20m
  rollback_triggers:
    latency_p50_ms: 220
    error_rate_percent: 0.8
    quality_regression_delta: 0.02
```
Natalie: Also enabling prefix cache warmup during the 5% -> 20% transition.

Ben: I’ll add temporary Alerts: `latency_p50 > 220ms for 5m`, `errors > 0.8% for 3m`, and `quality delta > 0.02 for 10m`. Who owns auto-rollback?

Aisha: Auto-rollback OFF. Human decision for now — Sam/Cheng/Aisha must ack to rollback. We do auto-fallback for routing to the compatible model variant if capacity dips.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job `frac-release-2026-03-17` for 2026-03-17T02:15:00-07:00 (PT). Job id: job_20260317_421.

Cheng: I’ll run the deployment at 02:20 PT and hold at each stage. Will post `stage:enter` and `stage:ok` messages in thread.

ops-oncall: I’ll be on-call during the window. I’ve added the incident channel hook and escalation rule to page at high severity. If page happens, escalate to oncall+eng-release.

Aisha: Preflight items — please confirm by EOD today: 
- Cheng: deployment runbook updated?
- Sam: smoke test checklist in the runbook?
- Ben: alerts created and documented?
- Natalie: rollout YAML pushed to repo and config validated?

Cheng: Runbook updated and linked in PR #872.

Sam: Smoke tests added to runbook, gating queries included.

Ben: Alerts created and test alerts fired, will leave the doc in the release PR.

Natalie: YAML validated locally, config PR #873 opened.

Aisha: Perfect. If anyone needs to opt-out of the window, reply here now. Otherwise we move forward and I’ll post the final go/no-go 90 mins before window. :thumbsup:
